q: Describe a time you stayed calm in an emergency or stressful situation.
a:
In my role as a Customer Relations Associate, we had a technical issue during one of the most intense hours and the service went down for a short time.

I stayed calm and focused on managing the situation effectively. First, I informed the customers about the situation in a clear and transparent way to reduce uncertainty. At the same time, I communicated with the technical team to get information about the issue.

I also handled customer concerns with patience and listened carefully. Instead of being affected by the pressure, I stayed professional and solution-oriented.

When everything was back to normal, I made sure everything was working properly.

This experience showed me the importance of staying calm under pressure, communicating clearly, and maintaining control in unexpected situations.
